Unmodified reference source, tests and fixtures from LibraryOfCongress/bagit-python,
commit `4bd2713cedbe1f8e634567c20ef0dded9622011d` (retrieved 2026-11-25).

Source: https://github.com/LibraryOfCongress/bagit-python

`reference.py` is upstream `src/bagit/__init__.py`. `test.py` and `test-data/`
are copied unchanged. Upstream declares its code public domain. The photographs
are upstream's test fixtures; see `test-data/README` for their attribution.

These files are test-only and are excluded from the published npm package.
